description: section-team for Claude Code: a supervisor plus specialist Opus agents, an Opus code-review gate, saved reports and a Team Board

plugins.name: section-team
plugins.description: Turns each Claude Code session into a supervisor that hands every job to Opus specialist agents (frontend, backend, testing and more) behind an Opus code-review gate, with saved reports and a live Team Board. Costs about 7x plain Claude Code in Balanced and 10x in Max; /team mode off turns it off for one project.
